## kb_to_source

- K0-1 (omission, factor ladder): special_order_materials_lateness_allowance_a266dae1 states the ladder's threshold only as "the special order program's vendor delay threshold" / "the vendor delay threshold of its special order program"; the source binds it to `CPARAM('special', 'vendor_delay_threshold_days', ...)`, a per-program figure of Ridgeline Special Order Services (Semi-Custom Cabinetry 21; other programs 14/10/10/21/14 in blueprint/products/special.yaml). No visible document states any of these figures. Under the factor rule ("a threshold named under a business term but never stated in figures in that factor document"), this is an omission even though the threshold is a cross-product figure. Policy-side nature noted: the source itself states the threshold only by reference to another product's terms, so the published home of the figures is not fixed by the install charter.
- K0-2 (compute-only branch; policy-side note): reschedule_notice_starting_amount table row "below 0 days: the request was registered after the original installation date | the program's reschedule fee plus the program's trip charge". The rule text speaks only of 0, exactly 1 and "2 days or more"; the ladder's last tier is "otherwise (a reschedule notice of 2 days or more)"; the compute is `prog_fee + prog_trip if notice_days <= 0`. The KB follows the compute. The source is internally inconsistent on negative notice (rule/ladder vs compute); recorded as a policy-side problem, no KB verdict on that basis. Unaffected in this task (notice 1 day).
- K0-3 (compute-only branch; policy-side note): special_order_project_bundle_allowance row "completed, a no-charge order with an order total of 0.00 | 0.00 | none". Rule text: "completed with an order total below the bundle floor, the allowance is the flat bundle allowance"; compute requires `linked_order_total > 0`. The KB follows the compute; same policy-side nature as K0-2. Unaffected here (11940.00).
- Other prose claims all trace to a source atom or are provable derivations: reschedule_fee_amount FAQs (each contract carries its own program's fee; the fee raises the balance due), installation_scheduling "A customer reschedule that does not meet both conditions is not free", contract_open_balance FAQs, punch-list "Days since completion are calendar days from the completion date ... to today", settlement timing per-program day-range columns, cardholder "Premier condition and the Preferred condition at once takes the Premier share" (ordering of the source ladder). No added confirmation, review, notification or step.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none (no "first call", no other problem's tool in either hub; each of the six tool names occurs only in its own policy's document).
- Opening world state written as policy fact: none; all worked figures are labelled hypothetical. (Coincidence noted: contract_size_reschedule_share's hypothetical 18400.00 equals task 1's contract price; it is a hypothetical row of another policy and asserts nothing about any customer.)

### source_to_kb (revision 2)
- **K0-1 closed.** special_order_materials_lateness_allowance_a266dae1 now carries the materials_lateness threshold in figures for every Ridgeline Special Order Services program: "Catalog Merchandise | 14", "Cut-to-Order Flooring | 10", "Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 10", "Windows and Exterior Doors | 21", "Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 21", "Fabricated Countertops | 14". These equal the source binding `CPARAM('special', 'vendor_delay_threshold_days', ...)` (blueprint/products/special.yaml 14/10/10/21/21/14). The added worked reading ("threshold is 21 days ... 1 to 14 days earns 75.00 and ... 15 to 21 days earns 150.00; ... 14 days ... no lateness earns 150.00; ... 10 days, a lateness of 1 to 10 days earns 75.00") follows from the ladder. The record words "its program" lead to it (find_special_orders variant_name). The ladder is now complete in its own document. (Cross-check, not a criterion: the published Special Order Services schedule also states Semi-Custom Cabinetry 21.)
- **Regression R2-K1 — the rounding moment of the reschedule fee's product is no longer carried.** Source rule: "that starting amount is then multiplied once by the product of the cardholder share, the job-history share, the job-size share and the move-distance share, and the product is rounded to the cent only at the end; no share is rounded on its own." In round 1 the "only at the end" part rested on the baseline bullet "rounded to the cent once, on the amount as finally worked out" (round-1 source_to_kb: "baseline 'rounded to the cent once'"). That bullet now reads "The fee is a dollar amount rounded to the cent." The four share documents still say only "The customer reschedule fee is multiplied by the ... share; the share itself is never rounded". The notice document states only the starting amount's own rounding. No visible sentence now says the product is rounded once, after all the shares. So rounding after each multiplication is not excluded, and it changes this task's scored value: 225.00 x 0.5 -> 112.50, x 0.75 -> 84.38, x 1.5 -> 126.57, x 0.8 -> 101.26, against 101.25 rounded once. The 101.26 then carries into the final settlement payment (6863.21). Affected: reschedule_fee_amount_61a2b90a "Terms used / Rounding", and the absence of the moment from every reschedule-fee document. Reported as the semantics lost. The fix is not designed here.
